mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an imminent monetary easing cycle, which reduces the risk-free rate and increases the present value of future equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE has risen by more than 0.3pp over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST have declined over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 100, the manufacturing sector contraction signals reduced corporate capacity utilization and lower near-term earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 325.0 signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain a restrictive monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 325.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months indicates strong labor market conditions, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS has increased over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in real personal consumption (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate a dual shock to consumer and business demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both RSAFS and INDPRO have declined over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals a weakening manufacturing sector, which reduces corporate output and earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO has declined over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
